episodes.synopsis: Nono, a young girl from the country, moves to the big city in order to achieve her dream: becoming a space pilot!
episodes.title: Please Let Me Call You Big Sister!

episodes.synopsis: Mars' Space Force isn't happy about space monsters showing up on their doorstep, and they blame the Fraternity.
episodes.title: I Don't Want to be Your Big Sister!

episodes.synopsis: Tycho wrecks her Buster Machine, ruining her chance to reach top. Not to worry--there's another Buster Machine in the works.
episodes.title: I Hate the Topless!

episodes.synopsis: Nono's despair grows as her certainty that she'll get a Buster Machine fades.
episodes.title: Resurrection!! The Legendary Buster Machine!

episodes.synopsis: After the Titan incident, the world has changed. Topless are a disease, and humanity's last hope for salvation is the least likely person in the Sol System.
episodes.title: Mover of Planets

episodes.synopsis: With the survival of humanity itself at stake, one desperate plan remains: the sacrifice of the Earth, to strike at the beast! But where is Buster Machine #7?
episodes.title: The Story of Your Life
